_comment: A worked example. Copy to corrections.json to make it live -- this file is never read.
This is exactly what the dashboard's manage mode writes when you press Export patch (JSON),
so the normal route is to make the edits on the page, download the patch, and commit it.
The merge policy is scanner-wins. A correction may set publishState, processingConclusion,
processingResultUrl, disputed and disputeNote -- judgement, which no adapter produces. It may
not set anything a source measured. If you disagree with a measured value, dispute it: the
record keeps what the source said and carries the objection beside it.
Anything that does not apply is reported, and publish --strict refuses over it.
